crossRefs.note: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
(which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t…
I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from…
Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders…
We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and…
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through…
Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of…

translations.web: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
translations.bsb: Please inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers.
translations.kjv: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
translations.asv: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, And apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out:
